optimized_revision: Enclosing implementation commit; measured uncommitted source tree
source_scope: Analysis, RAW, formation and CLI delivery source was frozen throughout these measurements. The final GUI scheduler shared-wait lease was added afterwards; it is covered by final GUI/concurrency and full-suite validation and is not on these measured CLI/formation paths.

scope.process: fresh process per one RAW/one output mode; all benchmarks serial
scope.timing: stages exclude input/output hashing and import; baseline retains CLI Y/EV result planes; optimized summary-only returns neither
scope.rss: process high-water RSS includes verification buffers; not physical footprint or GPU allocation
scope.hdr: packed production RGBA half and pre-pack exact headroom; Fuji has zero authorized extension, so it does not prove positive-headroom HDR delivery
scope.limits: Three local RAWs and one Apple decode; no claim to cover every DNG, proprietary RAW, system decoder or 61MP resource workload
